subject: Security scope confirmation + certification timeline for Farrington Health
body:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Farrington <alex.farrington@farringtonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: scope confirmation + proposed cert timeline

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call highlights:
- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood for user-facing clinical note summarization (PHI in scope) and internal search embedding for research.
- Compliance posture you care about: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA BAAs, and longer-term ISO 27001 / FedRAMP alignment for cloud integrations.
- Key constraint: some workloads must remain within your VPC or dedicated tenancy due to contract risk class.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Fill out the attached vendor security questionnaire (thanks for pointing to the template).
2) Confirm whether the initial SOC 2 scope should include research datasets (de-identified) or exclude entirely — you mentioned possibly expanding scope later.
3) Share your desired certification timeline window (you mentioned early Q2 would be ideal for SOC expansion).

Proposed Redwood actions:
- I will upload our SOC 2 attestation and provide a tailored scope proposal showing which model endpoints can run in your dedicated tenancy vs hosted API.
- CC'ing Neha to coordinate the technical fit/connector notes and Monica to start a compliance intake if you want us to treat this as a formal BAA + scope expansion.

Attachments: Farrington_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SOC2_Attestation_Request.pdf (pdf stub)

Next steps: could we target Wednesday 12/2 for a 30-min follow-up to review the completed questionnaire and agree on SOC scope? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
David Kim
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Farrington <alex.farrington@farringtonhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Liu <r.liu@farringtonhealth.com>, IT Security Team <security@farringtonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scope confirmation + proposed cert timeline

David —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers: 
- We'll complete the questionnaire by EOD Tuesday (11/30). Rachel will own this internally and loop IT Security for any technical clarifications.
- For the SOC 2 scope: start narrow — include production clinical note generation (PHI) and embedding pipeline for search. Research datasets should be excluded from initial SOC scope and considered for expansion in Q3.
- Timeline: aiming for SOC scope expansion approval by early Q2 (April) is realistic if the initial intake happens this month. 

Also we need clarity on: 1) how Redwood handles KV cache encryption for tokenized PHI, and 2) whether dedicated deployment would meet our data retention controls. Can your security team provide short answers?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, Farrington Health

---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Farrington <alex.farrington@farringtonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scope confirmation + proposed cert timeline

Alex —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Rachel/IT team, if helpful, Neha and I can hop on a 15-min tech clarifying call tomorrow morning to answer the two items you listed. Monica can speak to encryption-at-rest, retention SLAs, and how Redwood maps to typical SOC control families. 

Quick answers while we schedule the call: 
- KV cache & PHI: Our hosted runtime never persistently writes KV cache to customer-facing storage in plaintext. For dedicated and private deployments we encrypt KV caches at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and we can apply retention windows per-route.
- Dedicated deployment: meets data residency and retention controls. You can configure automatic purge policies and audit logging; Monica can share the audit-log sample schema.

I've attached a short scope proposal (redwood-scope-proposal-Nov2026.pdf). We'll also upload the signed SOC 2 Type II attestation once procurement signs the NDA/BAA.

Proposed 15-min slots for tech clarifier: Tue 11/30 9:00-9:15 PT or 10:30-10:45 PT. Which works?

Cheers,
David

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Farrington <alex.farrington@farringtonhealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scope confirmation + proposed cert timeline

Hi Alex —

Following up on David's notes with a few compliance-specific clarifications for your auditors and procurement team: 

- Encryption and key management: For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS) and HSM integration for highest-control customers. We can provide a KMS key rotation policy summary and HSM attestation excerpt if required.
- Audit logs & retention: We retain structured audit logs for API calls and admin actions; sample schema attached on request. Logs can be routed to your logging collector (S3, Cloud Storage, or SIEM) in near-real time.
- BAAs & contractual terms: We have a standard BAA template; major redlines we've accepted recently are around subprocessor disclosure cadence and breach notification timelines.
- ISO/FedRAMP path: We recommend the two-stage approach — 1) expand SOC 2 scope to include production endpoints this quarter, 2) parallelize ISO 27001 gap remediation for controls that overlap with FedRAMP low baseline. We can provide a gap matrix if you want to evaluate tradeoffs.

Attachments we can provide immediately: SOC2 Type II summary, KMS integration guide, and an audit-log schema example.

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Farrington <alex.farrington@farringtonhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Liu <r.liu@farringtonhealth.com>, IT Security Team <security@farringtonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: scope confirmation + proposed cert timeline

Thanks all —

Let's take Tue 11/30 10:30 PT for the 15-min call. Rachel will bring the filled questionnaire and IT Security will join. Key outcomes from the call:
- Confirmed answers for KV encryption and purge policy (so procurement can evaluate BAA redlines).
- Agreement to start with production clinical endpoints in SOC scope and defer research pipelines.
- Monica to send the audit-log schema and KMS integration notes post-call.

If we get that in place this week, Farrington will aim to complete procurement sign-off by mid-December so we can begin remediations and target SOC scope expansion in Q2.

Appreciate the quick support.

—Alex
